orgs.name: KCNT1 Epilepsy Foundation
orgs.snippet: Based in the U.S. and serving the global KCNT1 community, we exist to accelerate research and shape the future of care.

orgs.name: KCNT1 International Registry
orgs.snippet: This study is open to anyone who has a KCNT1-related condition diagnosis and meets the study inclusion criteria for participation.

orgs.name: KCNT1 Family Contact List
orgs.snippet: The KCNT1 Foundation serves as the central point of contact and is keeping a Family Contact List of families impacted by this disease.

orgs.name: KCNT1 Specialist Network
orgs.snippet: Be part of a growing network of specialists committed to KCNT1 epilepsy care.
